text: {"lessons":["My early sales of Stock A and Stock D locked in gains, but they did not prevent my account value from falling afterward; a winning trade is not the same as a winning portfolio.","After Period 5, I made no trades while my account value later recovered and rose, reminding me that patience can be a sound choice when my reasons for trading are weak.","I will review each holding and my overall portfolio on their merits, rather than selling just because a position is profitable or reacting to a short run of account changes."]}
